implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide a grid of squares with clues for across and down entries.
implemented_requirements.evidence: Functions `show()` and `show_clues()` render a printable grid with blocked cells (##) and start‑cell numbers. `build()` creates the internal grid based on the PUZZLE definition.

implemented_requirements.requirement: User can enter words by specifying the clue number and direction.
implemented_requirements.evidence: The main input loop parses commands of the form `<number> <across|down> <word>` and calls `fill(num, d, word)`.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Application validates if letters match existing letters on the grid.
implemented_requirements.evidence: `fill()` checks each cell for conflicts (`if cur and cur != word[i]:`) before accepting a word.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Application confirms completion when all correct words are filled in.
implemented_requirements.evidence: `done()` returns True only when every clue satisfies `solved(p)`. When True, the program prints "Congratulations - the puzzle is complete!".

judge.summary: The script implements a functional console crossword puzzle: it builds a grid, displays clues, accepts word entries by clue number and direction, validates letter placement, and detects when the puzzle is fully solved. All core requirements are present and the code appears ready to run without modification.
